{{Otheruses|Boot}}
'''Hover boots''', invented by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated/Legends|Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated]] engineers to aid in the building of skyscrapers, were boots equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] that could raise or lower the wearer, though not move them laterally. The engines controls could be manipulated with the wearer's toes. Hover boots were not self-powered, and required a [[hover transformer]] within 60 meters, which could power up to nine other pairs of boots. Hover boots could carry a user no higher than 60 meters, ascending at a maximum of 2.5 meters per second, and descending at no more than 5 meters per second.

Hover boots were used in the [[Nubian]] sport of [[Grav-ball/Legends|grav-ball]].
